text:
Sol Duarte: Hey team! Sol here — super excited to join the Platform team. Day one remote for me. Laptop's in transit; anyone got a quick workaround so I can start pairing? I'm PST (UTC-8).
Marcus Li: welcome Sol!! 🎉 I'll check with infra for a spare loaner. In the meantime, I can give you a dev VM. DMing creds in a sec.
devex-bot: Onboarding checklist created for @Sol Duarte — complete MDM enrollment, enable 2FA, join #platform and #oncall-shadow. Docs: https://intra.redwood/handbook/onboarding
Jamie Ortiz: hi Sol — I'm your buddy. We'll do a 30m intro/stack walkthrough at 10am PT, I'll send a calendar invite. Coffee prefs? :coffee:
Lia Chen: Welcome Sol! HR here — benefits email should've landed. Ping me if you need anything on payroll/NDAs. :tada:
Alex Romero: For a quick SSH into the dev VM, use: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 sol@devvm.redwood` — if you don't have keys: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sol@redwood.com"` then paste the public key in the onboarding form.
Sol Duarte: Awesome, thanks Marcus + Alex. Got the VM creds, logging in now. Jamie — oat milk latte pls. Also morning stand might be early for my timezone, so I'll hop on after the 10am pairing.
Marcus Li: Cool — added you to #platform and #oncall-shadow. If laptop shows up later today we'll swap. If anything weird with the VM ping me here or DM.
Jamie Ortiz: Team tradition: post a photo of your weird mug. Also we do a 1-week "show & tell" — what you're excited to work on. :mug:
Sol Duarte: Will do — fun fact: I used to compete in bonsai shows. Will post mug + bonsai pic. Looking forward to pairing and the ramen recs. Thanks everyone!
